title: 工作与求职对话词汇
goal: 理解求职和工作安排词汇，核对岗位要求与个人条件。

points.label: 识别求职与工作安排的词汇
听懂岗位要求和个人条件的对应

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）
sources.used: 长对话材料的教学依据

body.p: 求职与工作对话常谈岗位要求、个人经验和工作安排。答题时分清三类信息：职位的要求、申请人的条件、双方确认的安排。

body.box:
A: The vacancy involves answering calls. Have you done that before?
B: Yes. I answered calls at a visitor center last year.

body.p: Vacancy 指空缺职位。申请人曾接听电话，与岗位职责对应。

cards.title: 词汇表：岗位要求
rows: List the qualifications on the form.

cards.title: 词汇表：工作安排
rows: The morning shift begins at eight.
The deadline for the report is Friday.
Her first task is sorting the files.
The manager will assign the tasks.
Lee will replace Kim on that shift.
Arrange a time for the meeting.
They postponed the meeting until Friday.
A colleague will open the office.
Ask the supervisor about the schedule.

cards.title: 词汇表：工作评价
rows: The report describes the team's progress.
The team plans to improve its service.
He is reliable and arrives on time.
Checking the list is her responsibility.

body.box:
Interviewer: This vacancy involves answering calls and arranging visits. Have you done similar work?
Applicant: Yes. At a visitor center last year, I answered calls and booked tours.
Interviewer: The shift is on Saturday mornings. Are you available then?
Applicant: Yes, I can work every Saturday morning.
Interviewer: Good. Training begins next week.

Which experience matches a duty of the position?
1. Preparing reports for a training course
2. Answering calls at a visitor center
3. Supervising staff on Saturday evenings
4. Arranging a course at the visitor center

body.p: 岗位职责包括 answering calls。申请人去年在访客中心接听过电话，第二项把这段经验与职责对应起来。

lines.text: Is there a vacancy at the office?
Yes, they're looking for a new assistant.

options: An open position for a worker
A training course for a manager
items.why: Looking for a new assistant 说明 vacancy 是空缺职位，即第二项。

lines.text: Which shift do you work?
I'm on duty from eight until noon.

items.why: On duty from eight until noon 说明 shift 是轮班时段，即第一项。

lines.text: Do you have experience with customers?
Yes, I served visitors at a museum.

options: A plan to apply for work
A new duty at the museum
A record of past practical work
items.why: Served visitors at a museum 说明 experience 是过去的实际工作经验，即第三项。

lines.text: Did the supervisor give you feedback?
Yes, she commented on my report.

items.why: Commented on my report 说明 feedback 是主管的意见，即第四项。

lines.text: The assistant position involves greeting visitors.
I greeted visitors at a museum last summer.
The shift is on Wednesday afternoons.
I'm available then, but I have class on Thursday.
Wednesday is the only required day.
That's suitable for me.
Please send your application by Monday.
I'll send it this weekend.

items.stem: Which past experience matches the assistant's duty?
items.why: Greeted visitors at a museum 与 greeting visitors 的职责对应，即第一项。

items.stem: When is the applicant available for the shift?
items.why: Wednesday afternoons 后的 I'm available then 表明申请人该时段有空，即第三项。

items.stem: An office has a vacancy for an assistant. What is a vacancy?
items.why: Vacancy 指空缺职位，即第一项。

items.stem: A worker has a morning shift. What does shift mean?
options: A task due in the morning
items.why: Shift 指轮班时段，即第二项。

items.stem: An applicant has experience answering calls. What does experience refer to?
options: A plan for a future interview
items.why: Experience 指实际经历或经验，此处是接听电话的经验，即第三项。

items.stem: The supervisor gave feedback on a report. What was given?
items.why: Feedback 指对报告的反馈意见，即第四项。

items.stem: The meeting was postponed until Friday. What happened?
options: It was moved to a later time.
It was confirmed for the original time.
It was assigned to a new supervisor.
items.why: Postponed until Friday 表示会议被推迟到周五，即第一项。

items.stem: A worker is punctual. What does this mean?
items.why: Punctual 表示守时，即第二项。

lines.text: This part-time position involves greeting visitors and answering calls at our information desk. Have you done either of those tasks before?
Yes. Last summer I worked at a museum. I greeted visitors and answered questions about opening hours, although I didn't answer the museum's phone.
That visitor experience is useful. The shift here is on Tuesday afternoons. Are you available at that time?
Yes, I have classes on Monday and Wednesday afternoons, but Tuesday is free. Could you tell me about training?
New staff spend their first afternoon with a supervisor who explains the telephone system and the visitor information.
That would help me learn the phone duties.
Please send your application by Friday.
I'll send it tomorrow.

items.stem: Which requirement matches the applicant's previous work?
options: Explaining the phone system to staff
Greeting people at an information point
items.why: Greeted visitors at a museum 与岗位的 greeting visitors 对应，即第三项。

items.stem: Why can the applicant take the shift?
options: Classes end before every afternoon shift.
Wednesday afternoons are free of classes.
Tuesday afternoon is free of classes.
items.why: Tuesday is free 说明申请人周二下午有空，即第四项。

lines.text: We're looking for an assistant to organize files and prepare meeting rooms. What relevant experience do you have?
At my previous office I organized files every morning. Another colleague prepared the meeting rooms, but I helped when the office was busy.
The position requires a Friday morning shift. Would that suit you?
I'm available on Friday mornings. I work elsewhere on Thursday evenings, so I can't take an evening shift then.
Friday morning is the only shift for this role. The supervisor provides training on the filing system during the first week.
That schedule and training both sound suitable.
Please include a reference with your application.
I'll send the application and reference on Monday.

items.stem: Which duty did the applicant perform regularly?
options: Organizing files in the previous office
Training supervisors in a filing system
items.why: I organized files every morning 说明申请人经常整理文件，即第一项。

items.stem: What will the applicant include with the application?
options: Details of the Thursday evening job
A reference the employer can contact
Proof of training in the filing system
A record of past filing work
items.why: Include a reference 后的 I'll send the application and reference 确认随申请提交推荐人信息，即第二项。
